w24 NDD
```{r}
#W24
hold_w24<-n_w24
Result_table<- matrix(data=NA, nrow=684, ncol=5)
colnames(Result_table) <- c("Metabolites","OR", "CIL","CIH",
                            "p.value")
Result_table <- as.data.frame(Result_table)
j<- 1
for (i in 21:length(names(hold_w24)))
{
  my.formula <- paste("neu_dev")
  x.var <- paste(names(hold_w24)[i],"+ sex+
                             motherage + mother_smoking +ab_preg_yn + preeclampsia3rdtrimester +mother_bmi +ga +birthweight +familyincome_at1week +maternal_education_at1w+ paternal_education_at1w+alcohol_all+diabetes_all+VD+fish_oil" )
  my.glm.formula <- as.formula(paste0(my.formula," ~ ", x.var))
  glm_model <- glm(my.glm.formula, data=hold_w24,family = "binomial")
  print(tidy(glm_model))
  Result_table[j,1] <- names(hold_w24)[i]
  Result_table[j,2] <- round(exp(coef(glm_model)), 2)[2]#exp
  Result_table[j,3] <- round(exp(confint(glm_model)), 2)[2,1]#exp
  Result_table[j,4] <- round(exp(confint(glm_model)), 2)[2,2]#
  Result_table[j,5] <- round(tidy(glm_model)$p.value,4)[2]
  j <- j+1
}
################################################################
################################################################
pathway<-all_annotation

colnames(pathway)[1]<-"Metabolites"
colnames(pathway)[2]<-"Super_pathway"
Result_table_name<-left_join(Result_table, pathway
                        %>% dplyr::select(Metabolites,CHEMICAL_NAME,Super_pathway), by ="Metabolites")##

names(Result_table_name)
Result_table_fdr_neu_w24<-Result_table_name%>%
  mutate(FDR= p.adjust(Result_table_name$p.value,method="fdr"))

write.csv(Result_table_fdr_neu_w24,file="~/Result_table_fdr_NDD_w24_adj_fv.csv")

Result_table_Significant_neu_w24 <- subset(Result_table_fdr_neu_w24,p.value<= 0.05)
logtransform <- function(x, na.rm = FALSE) (x %>% log())
Result_table_Significant_neu_w24_log <- Result_table_Significant_neu_w24 %>% mutate(across(c("OR":"CIH"), logtransform))

Result_table_Significant_neu_w24_log<-Result_table_Significant_neu_w24_log[with(Result_table_Significant_neu_w24_log,order(FDR)),]

#######plot the data
plot_NDD_w24_adj <- Result_table_Significant_neu_w24_log %>%
  group_by(Super_pathway) %>%
  mutate(CHEMICAL_NAME = fct_reorder(CHEMICAL_NAME, p.value)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = OR, y = CHEMICAL_NAME, color = Super_pathway)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = CIL, xmax = CIH), width = 0.2, color = "grey40"
  ) +  # Error bars first
  geom_point(size = 3) +  # Points on top
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = if_else(FDR<0.05, "**", if_else(p.value<0.05, "*", ""))),
    box.padding = 0.15,  # Minimally pad the text box to keep text close
    point.padding = 0.05,  # Minimize padding from the point to avoid large gaps
    size = 4, segment.color = 'grey50',
    nudge_x = 0.15,  # Carefully adjusted to ensure text is close to the error bar end; adjust based on your plot's scale
    nudge_y = 0,  # Keep y position aligned with the data point
    direction = "y"  # Encourage vertical movement over horizontal to keep text aligned and close
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "longdash", color = "grey50") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10,color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "", x = "log(OR)", title = "W24_Any NDDs-adjusted (46) (fishoil + VD)",
    color = "Pathway"
  )

plot_NDD_w24_adj

Result_table_Significant_neu_w24_log_20 <- Result_table_Significant_neu_w24_log %>%
 arrange(desc(abs(OR))) %>%
  slice(1:20)

```

  Result_table[j,3] <- round(exp(confint(glm_model)), 2)[2,1]#exp
  Result_table[j,4] <- round(exp(confint(glm_model)), 2)[2,2]#
  Result_table[j,5] <- round(tidy(glm_model)$p.value,4)[2]
  j <- j+1
}

Result_table<- matrix(data=NA, nrow=684, ncol=5)
colnames(Result_table) <- c("Metabolites","OR", "CIL","CIH",
                            "p.value")
Result_table <- as.data.frame(Result_table)
j<- 1
for (i in 9:length(names(hold_18mth)))
{
  my.formula <- paste("asd")
  x.var <- paste(names(hold_18mth)[i],"+ sex+ BMI18mth+VD+fish_oil" )
  
  my.glm.formula <- as.formula(paste0(my.formula," ~ ", x.var))
  glm_model <- glm(my.glm.formula, data=hold_18mth,family = "binomial")
  print(tidy(glm_model))
  Result_table[j,1] <- names(hold_18mth)[i]
  Result_table[j,2] <- round(exp(coef(glm_model)), 2)[2]#exp
  Result_table[j,3] <- round(exp(confint(glm_model)), 2)[2,1]#exp
  Result_table[j,4] <- round(exp(confint(glm_model)), 2)[2,2]#
  Result_table[j,5] <- round(tidy(glm_model)$p.value,4)[2]
  j <- j+1
}
